lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in at least six visible horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, maintaining a semi-regular geometric spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical columns of lighter intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, creating a defined grid pattern across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance shift from light to dark.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse arrangement of high-luminance blobs, primarily localized toward the base and leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) positioned near the pectoral fin and ventral-lateral flank.
